Data Summary

tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Samples",
    "Individuals",
    "Baseline samples",
    "Follow-up samples"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(qc),
    n_distinct(qc$individual),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "baseline"),
    sum(qc$timepoint == "follow-up")
  )
)
qc |>
  count(
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    name = "samples"
  )

Salmon Library Type

qc |>
  count(
    library_type,
    name = "samples"
  )

Salmon QC

Mapping Rate

qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  mutate(
    sample_order = row_number()
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      sample_order,
      mapping_rate
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples ordered by mapping rate",
    y = "Salmon mapping rate (%)"
  )

QC Summary

qc |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        mapping_rate,
        library_compatible_pct,
        decoy_pct,
        fragment_length_mean,
        fragment_length_sd,
        rrna_mean_pct,
        hbrna_mean_pct
      ),
      list(
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("metric", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(min|median|max)$"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(min, median, max),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    ),
    metric = metric |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  )

Sample QC Summary

sample_qc <- qc |>
  transmute(
    run,
    sample,
    individual,
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    mapping_rate =
      round(mapping_rate, 2),
    library_type,
    library_compatible_pct =
      round(library_compatible_pct, 2),
    decoy_pct =
      round(decoy_pct, 2),
    fragment_length_mean =
      round(fragment_length_mean, 2),
    fragment_length_sd =
      round(fragment_length_sd, 2),
    rrna_mean_pct =
      round(rrna_mean_pct, 2),
    hbrna_mean_pct =
      round(hbrna_mean_pct, 2)
  )
sample_qc
